[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031967/38994c0a363fa1b60a57cd90af4f67c386e3672f.png[/img]
Hello.
This is Momentum Games.

When it comes to playing the game, I hear that there are users who are having a hard time clearing puzzles,
I've added the ability to skip puzzles in a hurry!

Now you can enjoy the game without a puzzle blocking you from proceeding!

However, if you skip, it will be cleared as 1 star, so if you enjoy the puzzle, please aim for 3 stars!

Then I hope you continue to have fun playing the game!
